$comment: Normative (FLR-ADR-006, FLR-ADR-007): FS_lighting 0.1.0, registry/FS_lighting/spec.md. Applied to the extension's top-level data, extensions.FS_lighting, by a validator that implements FS_lighting and knows it (spec.md 1.2). FS_lighting adds no kind of element: its data is what a light gives (luminaires, keyed by the light's ID) and the named scenes of a house (scenes, records in the document's one space of IDs). What an ID names, a range's order, a colour temperature within a range and names that repeat are checked by the invariants (spec.md 2 and 3).
title: FS_lighting 0.1.0
description: Lighting design over FS_electrical's lights: what each luminaire gives - its light output, its colour temperature or tunable range, whether it dims - and named lighting scenes, each the luminaires it turns on, at what output and colour temperature.

luminaires.description: 2.1: what a light gives, by the ID of the light (an FS_electrical light, or an element of another extension that gives light).

scenes.description: 3.1: named lighting scenes: an ID -> record map; the IDs share the document's one space of IDs.

kelvin.description: 1.4: a correlated colour temperature, in kelvin.

lumens.description: Its light output at full, in lumens.

cct.description: Its colour temperature at full output; for a tunable-white luminaire, the one it gives when a scene names none.

cctRange.description: A tunable-white luminaire's range: its warmest and its coolest colour temperature (FS-LGHT-2.1.2: the first below the second).

dimmable.description: Whether its output can be dimmed.

extras.description: As Core 1.7: data no specification defines.

setting.title: Setting
setting.description: 3.1: how a scene sets one luminaire it turns on.

output.description: Its light output, in percent of full.

cct.description: The colour temperature it is set to; absent, the luminaire's own.

on.description: The luminaires it turns on, by ID, and how; every other is off.

extras.description: As Core 1.7: data no specification defines.
